description: Get changes/diffs of a specific commit. Return the file diffs for one commit. Use `get_commit` for metadata without the patch.

full_diff.description: Whether to return the full diff or only first page (default: false)

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath expression filtering the JSON result before return.

project_id.description: Project ID or complete URL-encoded path to project

sha.description: The commit hash or name of a repository branch or tag

name: get_commit_diff
